Test Summary: Verify an unauthenticated user is redirected to the Login page when accessing the Profile page directly
Test Step / Action:
Log out of the application or open the site in an unauthenticated/incognito session
Enter the Profile page URL directly in the address bar
Expected Result: User is redirected to the Login page since authentication is required to view the account Profile page

Test Summary: Verify a logged-in user can navigate to the Profile page via the Profile Settings header link
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Click on the Profile Settings link in the Header
Expected Result: User is navigated to the account section with the Profile tab displayed by default

Test Summary: Verify clicking the Profile tab within Account navigation displays the Profile section
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Account section
Click on the Profile tab
Expected Result: The Profile section loads displaying the Hello, [Name] Account greeting, Personal data and Login data sections

Test Summary: Verify a validation error is shown when First Name is cleared and Save changes is clicked
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Clear the First Name field
Click the Save changes button
Expected Result: A validation error message is displayed indicating First Name is required, and the change is not saved

Test Summary: Verify a validation error is shown when Last Name is cleared and Save changes is clicked
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Clear the Last Name field
Click the Save changes button
Expected Result: A validation error message is displayed indicating Last Name is required, and the change is not saved

Test Summary: Verify the First Name and Last Name fields sanitize script injection attempts
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Enter a script tag payload in the First Name field
Click the Save changes button
Expected Result: Input is sanitized/escaped by the system; no script executes and no cross-site scripting vulnerability is exposed

Test Summary: Verify clicking Save changes with valid updated data saves the changes successfully
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Update the First Name and/or Last Name field with valid values
Click the Save changes button
Test Data:
First Name: Jane
Last Name: Doe
Expected Result: The updated personal data is saved successfully, a success confirmation message is displayed, and the new values persist on page reload

Test Summary: Verify clicking Change email address opens the email change flow
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Click on the Change email address link
Expected Result: User is navigated to or shown a form/modal to update their registered email address

Test Summary: Verify the Change email address flow requires current password confirmation
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Click on the Change email address link
Enter a new email address without providing the current password
Submit the form
Expected Result: System requires the current password to confirm the email change and displays a validation error if it is not provided

Test Summary: Verify clicking Change password opens the password change flow
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Click on the Change password link
Expected Result: User is navigated to or shown a form/modal to update their account password

Test Summary: Verify the Change password flow requires the current password before allowing a new password to be set
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Click on the Change password link
Enter a new password without providing the current password
Submit the form
Expected Result: System requires the current password to confirm the password change and displays a validation error if it is not provided

Test Summary: Verify a validation error is shown when the New password is shorter than 8 characters
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Scroll to the Password section
Enter a password shorter than 8 characters in the New password field
Complete the remaining fields and click Save changes
Test Data:
New Password: Pass1
Password Confirmation: Pass1
Current Password: (valid current password)
Expected Result: A validation error is displayed indicating the password does not meet the minimum length requirement, and the password is not updated

Test Summary: Verify a validation error is shown when New password and Password confirmation do not match
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Scroll to the Password section
Enter mismatched values in the New password and Password confirmation fields
Complete the Current password field and click Save changes
Test Data:
New Password: NewPass@123
Password Confirmation: NewPass@456
Current Password: (valid current password)
Expected Result: A validation error is displayed indicating the password confirmation does not match, and the password is not updated

Test Summary: Verify a validation error is shown when Current password is left empty on Save changes
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Scroll to the Password section
Enter matching values in the New password and Password confirmation fields
Leave the Current password field empty and click Save changes
Test Data:
New Password: NewPass@123
Password Confirmation: NewPass@123
Current Password: (empty)
Expected Result: A validation error is displayed indicating the current password is required to confirm the change, and the password is not updated

Test Summary: Verify an appropriate error is shown when an incorrect Current password is entered
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Scroll to the Password section
Enter matching values in the New password and Password confirmation fields
Enter an incorrect value in the Current password field and click Save changes
Test Data:
New Password: NewPass@123
Password Confirmation: NewPass@123
Current Password: WrongCurrentPass
Expected Result: An authentication error is displayed indicating the current password is incorrect, and the password is not updated

Test Summary: Verify the password updates successfully with a valid New password, matching confirmation and correct Current password
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Scroll to the Password section
Enter a valid New password and matching Password confirmation
Enter the correct Current password and click Save changes
Test Data:
New Password: NewPass@123
Password Confirmation: NewPass@123
Current Password: Pass@123
Expected Result: Password is updated successfully, a success confirmation message is displayed, and the user can subsequently log in using the new password

Test Summary: Verify the Password fields sanitize script injection attempts
Test Step / Action:
Log in with valid credentials
Navigate to the Profile page
Scroll to the Password section
Enter a script tag payload in the New password field
Complete the remaining fields and click Save changes
Test Data:
New Password: <script>alert('test')</script>
Password Confirmation: <script>alert('test')</script>
Current Password: (valid current password)
Expected Result: Input is sanitized/escaped by the system; no script executes and a standard validation error for an invalid password format is displayed
